import pandas as pd
p='task1_data_and_tasks/data/monona.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p,skiprows=2,header=None,names=['timestamp','water_temp_C','water_temp_qc','dissolved_oxygen','do_qc','wind_speed','wind_qc'])
df['timestamp']=pd.to_datetime(df.timestamp)
df['dissolved_oxygen']=pd.to_numeric(df.dissolved_oxygen)
df['do_qc']=pd.to_numeric(df.do_qc)
x=df[(df.timestamp>=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-25 08:00'))&(df.timestamp<pd.Timestamp('2026-07-26 08:00'))]
print(len(x),len(x[(x.do_qc==0)&(x.dissolved_oxygen<5)]))
print(x[(x.do_qc==0)&(x.dissolved_oxygen<5)][['timestamp','dissolved_oxygen']].to_string(index=False))
